verdict.rationale: Fastmail publishes API documentation (fastmail.com/dev) and API tokens. It exposes the open, fully documented JMAP protocol: a session object at /.well-known/jmap, OAuth 2.0 or Bearer auth, batched methodCalls for query, fetch and send, and push via EventSource or WebPush. Together these give an AI-native user a documented programmatic surface for driving the account. The OpenAPI probe 404s reflect a different spec format, not an absent API. Missing for 10: Fastmail-specific API docs and token pages are evidenced only by titles, with no detail on scope or coverage; no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving Fastmail via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Fetch `/.well-known/jmap` for the session object - capabilities, accounts, and all API URLs.
POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
No patents. No fees. Fully documented.
